vault.setup_description: Set a passphrase we will encrypt your financial data with. We do not know it and we have no way to recover it.
vault.passphrase_hint: At least 12 characters. A few words you will remember easily and nobody will guess works best.
vault.error_too_short: The passphrase must be at least 12 characters.
vault.recovery_subtitle: This is your only way back if you forget the passphrase.
vault.recovery_description: We show it once. We keep no copy of it — if you lose it along with your passphrase, nobody can recover your data.
vault.recovery_warning: Save it in a password manager now, or print it and put it somewhere safe.
vault.recovery_confirm_label: I have saved the recovery code somewhere safe
vault.unlock_description: Enter the passphrase you encrypted your data with. Refreshing the page does not need it — we ask again once you close the browser, and after 30 minutes of inactivity.
vault.use_recovery_code: I do not remember my passphrase — I will use the recovery code
vault.sync_failed_description: The copy on your Google Drive was encrypted with a different key. We are not overwriting it, so that nothing is lost — unlock with the matching passphrase or recovery code.
vault.unreadable_backup_title: There is an old-format copy on your Drive
vault.unreadable_backup_description: We are not overwriting it, because it is the only copy of that data.
vault.unreadable_backup_instruction: The folder {{directory}} on Google Drive holds a file {{file}} that this version cannot read — it predates the data passphrase, and the key to it was held by the server and no longer exists. Rename it to {{archived}} and refresh this page: Saldoo will then start a new, encrypted copy and leave the old file untouched.
vault.failed_title: We could not open your data
vault.failed_description: We could not check your protection on Google Drive. Refresh the page and try again.
vault.unavailable_title: We need a connection, just once
vault.unavailable_description: This is the first time Saldoo has run on this device, and your key is on Google Drive. Get online — from next time the app will work offline too.

onboarding.INTRODUCTION-description: We are glad you are joining us! We understand that your personal finances matter to you, but before we go any further we would like to walk you through the app in a few simple steps. Ready?
onboarding.SECURITY-description: Let us start with the basics: security. Saldoo set out to replace unwieldy spreadsheets with a proper tool for managing a budget. Collecting data about your finances is not the point of this app, so you hold all of it. The financial data you enter is processed on the device you run the app on — phone, tablet or computer. To move that data between devices we offer syncing with your own Google Drive, where it is stored encrypted; Saldoo knows how to decrypt it and show you your finances as they are. If you would like to export your data in a readable form, you can do that later in settings. Remember: if you do not sync Saldoo with your cloud and you clear your browser data, your data is gone.
onboarding.SETTINGS-description: To work properly the app does need a little information. We store your chosen currency and budgeting strategy for you, and we take care to protect them. Remember that WE DO NOT STORE OR PROCESS ANY DATA ABOUT YOUR FINANCES IN OUR OWN SYSTEMS.
onboarding.APP-description:
Saldoo is divided into a few sections. Briefly:

  • Dashboard the home page, with the main charts and analyses of your finances
  • Expenses you add planned expenses by hand (a holiday budget, recurring bills, subscriptions)
  • Duties a list of payments to tick off as paid
  • Profits you add income, such as your salary
  • Transactions you can load .csv files from your bank to tick off duties automatically and feed the analyses in Dashboard
